name: Piktochart
tagline: Piktochart is a visual communication tool for creating infographics, presentations, reports, and social graphics with a drag-and-drop editor. Its AI Report generator transforms raw data or a topic into a complete, visually structured document in seconds. Communications professionals and educators use it to make complex information accessible and shareable without graphic design training.
